comparison_interpretation: Pano-ORB-VO is a strong protocol-compatible classical baseline. It is competitive or better in alignment-corrected trajectory shape metrics, but its path_ratio is substantially lower than S5, indicating weaker path-length/scale stability. S5 remains the final clean candidate, but this comparison shows that it is not uniformly superior to classical VO.
thesis_wording: Under an alignment-consistent external trajectory evaluator, the proposed S5 system does not dominate the protocol-compatible classical panorama VO baseline on every metric. The classical baseline can be competitive in alignment-corrected trajectory shape, whereas S5 retains an advantage in path-length/scale stability, which remains important for a clean final candidate under the historical protocol.
caveats: official locked S5 metrics and external-eval alignment metrics answer different protocol questions
Pano-ORB-VO does not replace S5 final-candidate status
